name: NFT Data

Data is sourced from the OpenSea API and passed through as is, with currencies reported in the response (ETH, USDC, etc.). Costs $0.002 per successful request, paid in USDC on Base via x402 v2, with no API keys or subscriptions. Registered as OpenSea Tool #778 (ERC-8257).

Example: for the Milady Maker collection, send the slug “milady” (the identifier from the collection’s OpenSea URL) and receive its current floor price in ETH, sales and volume for the last 24 hours, 7 days and 30 days, lifetime totals, the number of unique owners, total supply, the contract address on Ethereum and the creation date.
